subject: Re: CloudForge Sell-With orchestration & metering evidence
content:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudforge.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: CloudForge + Redwood — Sell-With opportunity and metering asks

Hi Mateo,

Quick note to introduce CloudForge's GTM lead (Sam Green at Acme) — we're close to a co-sell pilot and Acme asked for a short checklist so they can qualify for a managed private-offer. They want clarity on: SKU entitlement mapping, how usage will be metered in the marketplace, and what sample telemetry we can provide for their procurement.

High-level asks:
- Joint demo (30m) with Acme next week to show the integration and co-sell flow.
- List of metering signals (API endpoints and example CSV) we can provide to Acme + marketplace partner team.
- Any standard PoC credits or demo SKUs Redwood can commit to for the pilot.

Sam is looped — can you confirm who on Redwood should own metering evidence and whether a Sell-With badge checklist exists?

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Partnerships, CloudForge
alyssa@cloudforge.com

----
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudForge + Redwood — Sell-With opportunity and metering asks

Alyssa — thanks for the intro and the concise ask. Excited to push this forward.

Quick answers and owners below:
- Metering evidence and SKU entitlement: Ben Carter will own the evidence pack and mapping (cc'd).
- Demo / PoC credits: Vivek can confirm a small sandbox quota for the joint demo and pilot credits.
- Badge checklist: Redwood has a Sell-With eligibility checklist; I'll attach a trimmed list after the internal sync.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Ben to confirm required artifacts and a priority checklist (by EOD tomorrow).
2) Set 30m joint demo with Acme — suggested windows: Tue 6/30 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed 7/1 14:00–16:00 PT.
3) Share a sample metering CSV and the list of telemetry fields we can produce (cost/usage tokens, SKU ID, region tag).

Ben / Vivek — could you please pick this up? I think the minimal deliverable for procurement is: 1) entitlement SKU map; 2) a one-page metering sample; 3) a copy of the Sell-With evidence checklist.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudforge.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudForge + Redwood — Sell-With opportunity and metering asks

Team — following up on Mateo's note. I pulled together a quick inventory of what procurement typically asks; attaching a small sample CSV and a skeleton evidence list.

Attachment stubs:
- RFQ_metering_sample.csv (CSV) — sample rows showing timestamp, sku_id, usage_tokens, tenant_id, region.
- joint-demo-deck-v2.pptx (PPTX) — draft slides for the co-demo.

Minimum evidence pack (what I'll put together):
- SKU entitlement map: mapping of marketplace SKU -> Redwood internal SKU -> feature gating.
- Metering schema: list of telemetry fields, example payloads, and retention policy.
- Telemetry export sample: RFQ_metering_sample.csv (see attachment).
- Security/compliance note: pointer to our Private deployment docs for PII handling.

Notes / questions for CloudForge:
- Which marketplace is Acme pursuing for private offer? (AWS GovCloud / AWS commercial / GCP private offers / Azure Managed) — the metering required will differ slightly.
- Do we need signed attestation for meter parity or is the sample CSV sufficient for initial procurement?

I'll draft the one-page Sell-With checklist and send by EOD. Vivek — can you confirm demo sandbox quota (500k tokens demo + reserved trial slot) and whether we need to provision a dedicated tenant? If yes, mention lead time.

-ben
Ben Carter
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

----
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudforge.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Sam Green <sam.green@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudForge + Redwood — Sell-With opportunity and metering asks

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Acme will pursue an AWS private offer (commercial). They reviewed Ben's sample and it looks good for initial procurement. A couple of confirmations before we lock the demo: 

- Demo slot: Tue 6/30 at 10:30 PT works for Sam and the Acme procurement lead.
- Sandbox quota: 500k tokens is fine for the joint demo; no dedicated tenant needed for the initial run. If pilot expands we'll revisit.
- Evidence pack: procurement expects the SKU entitlement map + the one-page metering schema and a link to PII/data handling docs. The sample CSV is sufficient for now, no attestation required at this stage.

I attached the CloudForge_SellWith_Requirements.pdf (requirements from Acme procurement) and included a short list of stakeholder names. Ben — can you confirm final delivery timeline for the one-pager and the entitlement map? Ideally we get them before EOD Monday so procurement can advance the private-offer paperwork.

Action items:
- Ben: finalize one-page metering schema + SKU entitlement map (target: Mon 6/29 EOD).
- Vivek: confirm sandbox provisioning and email instructions to Sam (target: Mon 6/29 afternoon).
- Mateo/Alyssa: run 30m joint demo Tue 6/30 10:30 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Partnerships, CloudForge
alyssa@cloudforge.com

--
Attachments referenced:
- CloudForge_SellWith_Requirements.pdf (PDF)
- RFQ_metering_sample.csv (CSV)
- joint-demo-deck-v2.pptx (PPTX)
